Guided horse ride through rice fields to the beach

1 hr - 1.5 hr · per booking, up to 5 riders · Bali · Run by Salty Cowboy

Overview

A guided ride out through the rice fields to the beach. Our grooms come with you the whole way, on foot, so this is a relaxed, well supported ride even if you've never been on a horse before.

FAQ

What's included in guided horse ride through rice fields to the beach?

Helmets and boots, Staff guiding on foot the whole way, Photos taken on your phone by our team.

How do I book?

Tap "Check dates with Salty Cowboy" below. You'll finish booking directly with Salty Cowboy, and Simone confirms your date on WhatsApp. No payment is taken on Threshold.

What are the start times?

Start times depend on the duration you choose. See the times table above, and note Salty Cowboy is closed Sundays and Saturday afternoons.

Is there a weight limit?

Max 75kg per rider with clothes on. Max 2 riders over 70kg per ride. Riders are weighed at the stables.

What if I need to cancel?

Cancellation terms are set by Salty Cowboy. Ask them before you book.
